item.title: Patch now: Project MONAI MONAI Label: Path Traversal
item.description:
Project MONAI MONAI Label: Path traversal (file read/write) · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 0.8.6

First step: Update Project MONAI MONAI Label to 0.8.6 or later.

Project MONAI MONAI Label contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to write arbitrary files outside the intended datastore directory, potentially resulting in remote code execution.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-133968
